description: Changes one contact by its `id` from `find_contact`: the fields you pass, leaving the rest. `notes` is for what is worth remembering next time (“prefers mornings”, “our contact at Acme for invoices”) and replaces what was there, so read it first and write the whole note. `kind: "agent"` marks an automated sender. `snoozed_until` (ISO 8601, a year ahead at most) mutes them: their new mail arrives snoozed and comes back to the inbox then; `null` unmutes. Nobody is told.
name: update_contact
title: Keep notes on a contact, or mute them
